text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: The monster seems stronger than before...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この魔物、
さっきより強そう……

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's mad 'cause we beat it up?
Y-you're the one who attacked us first, y'know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一回倒されたから怒っちゃったのかも？
さ、
先に手を出してきたのはそっちじゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't think it's listening to us, Mio!
It's a little scary, but... we have to stop it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
聞いてくれてないみたいですよミオちゃん！
戦うのは怖いですけど……
止めなくっちゃ！
